title: The stranded detector reports no-fix eval findings and route source findings, which no stage or command can move
goal: learn re-runs each no-fix eval finding's question with pack on HEAD and records fixed-since when it now passes, as it does for open findings, and the stranded detector leaves out route source findings, which are report-only and listed by querylog.py status; so stranded reports only findings a stage can still move. Planted tests in test_ql_learn.py (a no-fix finding whose question now passes, one that still misses) and test_intake.py (a route source finding older than STRANDED_DAYS) cover each case.
notes: Premise: python3 _tools/backlog.py intake reports three stranded findings on c413b82f: F-b28d0d79b19b and F-fe10582bc61f, eval findings no-fix since 2026-09-29 (querylog.py show --findings --state no-fix), and F-a69c6dbdf291, a route source finding (WebFetch read code.claude.com and modelcontextprotocol.io; querylog.py status). learn writes a record only for a finding whose last state is open or fixed-since (ql_learn.learn, LEARN_STATES), a route finding is derived again from the store's fetches on every run, and querylog.py close takes gap findings only, so none of the three can leave its state. F-fe10582bc61f's question (GitHub rulesets branch protection public repository) now packs good from public/gitlab/github-branch-rules-and-auto-merge.md while the finding expects public/gitlab/detecting-mr-merges-in-ci.md: what passes for a no-fix finding is the worker's to define and test. The three fingerprint links keep intake from filing a draft per finding while this bug is open.
